pluscismte.title: Is M&TE
pluscismte.remarks: Defines whether a Tool is a standard used for measuring and testing equipment.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: Describes the item or service. To view additional information, click the Long Description button.

pluscisinhousecal.title: Internal Calibration
pluscisinhousecal.remarks: When selected, indicates that this tool is calibrated in house. This field can be used to sort tools that are calibrated internally or externally.

receipttolerance.title: Receipt Tolerance %
receipttolerance.remarks: The percentage value of items that can be received over the amount set in the initial agreement.

plusgchemitem.title: Chemical Item
plusgchemitem.remarks: Indicates whether this item is a chemical.

plusdcuesalvagepct.title: Salvage Percentage (CUE)
plusdcuesalvagepct.remarks: Salvage percent of this item. The value is used in calculating the salvage amount on the Costs subtab of the Estimate Request tab in the CU Estimating application. To determine this value, analyze historical jobs to compare the quantity removed during a certain period to the quantity removed that were returned to a storeroom for salvage.

plusdmajormatl.title: Major
plusdmajormatl.remarks: Boolean indicator to identify  major material items.  These items are commonly referred to as property units.

plusproc.title: Procurement Class
plusproc.remarks: This field displays the quality level required by engineering for procurement and replacement.

plusgrestrcttype.title: Restriction Type
plusgrestrcttype.remarks: The category of restricted chemicals to which this chemical belongs.

maxissue.title: Maximum Quantity Issued
maxissue.remarks: Total maximum quantity that can be issued to an asset.

plusgrestricteduse.title: Restricted Use
plusgrestricteduse.remarks: Indicates whether the use of this item is restricted.

plusautobuy.title: Auto-Buy
plusautobuy.remarks: When selected, this item may be purchased without the consent of the procurement-engineering group

plusdcueunitcost.title: Unit Cost (CUE)
plusdcueunitcost.remarks: The unit price that is used on a compatible unit (CU) record. Enter the unit price for each service that you want to use on a compatible unit record.

groupname.title: Group
groupname.remarks: Meter group for the item.  This attribute pertains to rotating items only, and is used to set the GroupName attribute of the new asset created from this item during the application of an item assembly structure.

taxexempt.title: Tax Exempt
taxexempt.remarks: Select this check box if the item, the tool, or the service is not taxable. The buyer for your organization determines the tax-exempt status of items, of tools, and of services.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: Date the work order status was last changed.

inspectionrequired.title: Inspection Required
inspectionrequired.remarks: Indicates whether inspection of item is required upon receipt.

pluscismteclass.title: M&TE Classification
pluscismteclass.remarks: When the Is M&TE? field is checked then you have the option to choose a classification for M&TE.

plusgsafetycritical.title: Safety-Critical
plusgsafetycritical.remarks: Indicates whether this item is associated with safety-critical equipment.

iscrew.title: Crew
iscrew.remarks: Specifies whether the tool can be used in Crew applications and Work Order Tracking applications. If the check box is selected, the tool can be used. If the check box is cleared, the tool cannot be used.

hardresissue.title: Requires hard reservation on use
hardresissue.remarks: Indicates whether a hard reservation must be referenced when the item is issued from a storeroom.

plusdcueuom.title: Unit of Measure
plusdcueuom.remarks: Unit of measure for the standard service when it is used on CU records.

plusdtool.title: Use with T&D
plusdtool.remarks: Specifies whether the tool can be used in T&D applications. If the check box is  selected, the tool can be used with T&D applications. If the check box is cleared, the tool cannot be used.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The current status of the item such as ACTIVE, PENDING, PLANNING, PENDOBS and OBSELETE.
